text: Josiah{H2977} was eight{H8083} years{H8141} old{H1121} when he began to reign;{H4427} and he reigned{H4427} thirty{H7970} and one{H259} years{H8141} in Jerusalem.{H3389}

And [so did he] in the cities{H5892} of Manasseh{H4519} and Ephraim{H669} and Simeon,{H8095} even unto Naphtali,{H5321} in their ruins{H2719} round about.{H5439}
